notes.title: Update 1 - Hide and Seek and Video Options
notes.content:
The first update is now live!
This update includes a Hide and Seek mode, and some video options to help improve performance.

Hide and Seek mode can be toggled on in the options menu. This shows you how far each player is from you, instead of their height up the tower. This mode also allows you to jump higher and farther to be able to traverse the map more quickly. 

Play with whatever rules you would like, but I would recommend everyone starting in 1 location, then 1 player looks at the ground and counts to 100 while everyone else runs to find a good hiding spot (either up the tower or somewhere in the city), then the seeker goes to try and find everyone, using the distance to each player to help hone in on each one.

I have also included some video options that should help the game run more smoothly if you're experiencing low FPS. Turning off the VHS shader has the greatest impact, but makes the game less stylish. Turning off fog and lowering the view distance are also options, but both give only a small improvement in FPS

notes.title: Hotfix 3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Made grabbing onto ledges and pulling up more consistent
[/list]

I am looking for feedback on how grabbing ledges feels still. If you think it still isn't very consistent and doesn't always happen when you think it should, or if you think it feels better now and you generally grab ledges when you expect too, please let me know in the Steam discussions https://steamcommunity.com/app/2501590/discussions/

notes.title: Hotfix 2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed other player's names and characters not showing up correctly in multiplayer
[*] Fixed some translations not showing up
[/list]

Some players have reported extremely low FPS when running the game. Sometimes, restarting the game will fix this issue, but unfortunately not always. Please let me know in the Steam discussions if you are having this issue https://steamcommunity.com/app/2501590/discussions/
